## Overview

This PR adds five optional hooks to Model Runner V2's `BaseSpeculator`, so a speculator can verify drafts that are not a chain (a tree, for example), choose how many drafts each request verifies, and stop drafting when speculation stops paying off at large batch sizes. Each hook defaults to today's behavior, and the runner calls a per-step hook only when the speculator overrides it, so built-in speculators run as before.

Model Runner V2 verifies drafts as a chain, and only built-in adaptive verification can change how many drafts a step verifies. A tree verifier needs to rewrite positions and attention inputs before the target forward, supply its own rejection sampler, and move the accepted path's KV and recurrent state afterwards. A speculator that finds drafting no longer helps needs a way back to plain decode. The hooks sit at points where the runner already branches.

Builds on #62962; review the last 4 commits. Together the two let an out-of-tree speculator run tree verification on hybrid models.

## Claims

- `make_rejection_sampler(sampler)` lets the speculator supply the verifier. The default keeps the chain `RejectionSampler`, and `ModelState.custom_sampler` still takes precedence.
- `prepare_verify_inputs(input_batch, model_inputs, *, dummy_run)` runs before the target forward (in capture and dummy runs too), after positions, slot mappings and attention metadata exist. A tree verifier rewrites positions in place and stages what its attention backend reads.
- `post_accept(input_batch, sampler_output, num_sampled, num_rejected)` runs after sampling, before `num_computed_tokens` advances and before `propose`. A tree verifier moves the accepted path's KV and recurrent state to the slots the next step expects.
- `verify_budget(req_ids, num_draft_tokens)` returns how many of its scheduled drafts each request verifies this step, and the rest count as rejected. The runner trims the batch on the host before dispatch, so the token count and decode width that select the CUDA graph follow the budget. Built-in adaptive verification keeps precedence when enabled.
- `suspend_drafting(num_reqs, req_ids)` is asked once per scheduled batch when the speculator sets `may_suspend_drafting`. When it returns True, pending verification drains and the batch's requests decode with the target alone until they finish, on target-only attention metadata and decode CUDA graphs, without draft KV. A zero draft count behaves differently, because it still extends the draft KV.

## Validation

AI assistance (Claude) was used to prepare this change; I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests listed below.

All GPU rows ran Qwen3.8-27B at TP4 on 4x B300 with Model Runner V2 and greedy sampling. The MTP row ran this PR's code with #62962 underneath on `main` at `3dbf2b6c0c`. The other rows were measured on the previous base (`56e67b46a3`) with #62962 and #62961 underneath, on an earlier revision with the same hook bodies, whose runner called every hook on every step. The speculator rows served 88 SPEED-Bench first turns with up to 512 new tokens, one fresh server and one run per row, and their throughput is generated (output) tokens per second over the wall-clock time of the run.

| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| MTP (built-in, so no hook is called), 33 prompts at batch 1, `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` | Greedy outputs identical to the same build without this PR and #62962 (33 of 33), no sync errors, and the same mean acceptance length as without them |
| Out-of-tree tree speculator (custom sampler, verify-input and accepted-path hooks, `verify_budget`), 8 and 64 concurrent requests, measured on the previous base (`56e67b46a3`) | 3026 and 8391 output tok/s, against 1672 and 7378 without speculation |
| Chain speculator whose `suspend_drafting` stops drafting from 36 requests, 64 concurrent, measured on the previous base (`56e67b46a3`) | 63 drafts in 92,903 generated tokens, so the batch decoded with the target alone |
| Suspended decode, 8 and 64 requests of 128 tokens, full graph and eager, measured on the previous base (`56e67b46a3`) | Outputs identical to no speculation with no draft calls, at 0.92x the throughput of plain decode at 8 requests and 0.86x at 64 (full graph) |

The new tests check that the runner builds the chain sampler unless the speculator supplies one and calls only the hooks a speculator overrides (none for built-ins). They check that `verify_budget` trims the batch before dispatch, keeps prefill rows, and is not asked without drafts or with adaptive verification. They check that suspension sticks to each request, drains pending verification, uses its own metadata and graphs, calls no draft or verify hook, and rejects unsupported configurations. The changed runner tests cover KV-sharing layers in the target layer set, graph teardown for suspended decode, and its metadata without speculative state.

On CPU on this base (`VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu`, one pytest process per file), with #62962 underneath, the touched files and the attention, KV-cache and worker files they depend on pass 800 tests against 731 on `main` (`3dbf2b6c0c`), with no new failures. The 15 failures are the same on both trees, 7 in `test_gpu_model_runner.py` and 8 CPU-builder cases in `test_group_head_counts.py`. On B300 on `40210d8317`, the same files passed 599 tests with no failures, including all 31 in `test_gpu_speculator_verify_hooks.py`. `pre-commit` (mypy included) passes on this range.

```bash
pre-commit run --from-ref bc393e71536fc9718743c653d4e396707fe924f3 --to-ref HEAD
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu python -m pytest -q tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_speculator_verify_hooks.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner_v2_cudagraph_profiling.py tests/v1/worker/test_mamba_hybrid_model_state.py
VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --tensor-parallel-size 4 --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
```

## Not a duplicate

I ran the duplicate-work searches from `AGENTS.md` §1 (open PRs, with keywords for custom rejection samplers, tree verification hooks, verify budgets and suspending drafting). No open PR adds these Model Runner V2 hooks. These are related, and this PR uses no code from them:

- #53426 skips the draft forward at zero draft tokens for MTP and DFlash, as an operator opt-in. `suspend_drafting` is a decision the speculator makes per batch, and it also stops draft KV extension.
- #58340 reports the number of drafts verified under adaptive verification. The same metric would apply to `verify_budget`.
- #62682 adds approximate verification as a built-in rejection-sampling method. `make_rejection_sampler` lets an out-of-tree speculator supply its own sampler, and the two work side by side.

## Details

- The sampler contract is `RejectionSampler.__call__`'s (`sampled_token_ids`, `num_sampled`, `num_rejected`, and logprob rows in sampled-token order).
- The runner detects overrides once, when it builds the speculator, by comparing each hook on the speculator's class with `BaseSpeculator`'s.
- `suspend_drafting` and `verify_budget` take and return host data only (request ids and counts) and must not read device tensors.
- Suspended decode runs with synchronous scheduling and either eager execution or full decode graphs. When a speculator opts in, the runner rejects prefix caching, KV transfer, DBO, context, data or pipeline parallelism, and recurrent replay or recovery. Draft weights and KV capacity stay allocated.
- Non-chain verification with pipeline parallelism is outside this PR.

 - `speculative_config.method = "custom_class"`
 - `speculative_config.model = "your_module.YourCustomProposerClass"`
 
+## Out-of-Tree Speculative Methods (Experimental)
+
+A package can add a speculative method under its own name. It registers the
+method from a `vllm.general_plugins` entry point (see
+[Plugin System](../../design/plugin_system.md)):
+
+```python
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.registry import (
+    SpeculativeMethodSpec,
+    register_speculative_method,
+)
+
+
+def register():
+    register_speculative_method(
+        "my_method",
+        SpeculativeMethodSpec(speculator_cls="my_pkg.spec:MySpeculator"),
+    )
+```
+
+The method is then selected by name, and `method_config` is passed to it
+uninterpreted:
+
+```bash
+vllm serve <target-model> \
+  --speculative-config '{"method": "my_method", "model": "<draft-model>", "method_config": {"depth": 4}}'
+```
+
+`MySpeculator` is a Model Runner V2 speculator (a subclass of
+`vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.speculator.BaseSpeculator`), so registered
+methods always run on Model Runner V2. Unlike `custom_class`, a registered
+method keeps the draft model in `model`, and its `SpeculativeMethodSpec` tells
+vLLM what the drafter needs (target hidden states, auxiliary hidden states and
+lookahead KV slots).
+
+A method that verifies drafts other than a chain (a tree, for example) on a
+hybrid model with gated delta net or Mamba2 layers can also replace the
+spec-decode conv and recurrence of those layers. It names a factory in
+`SpeculativeMethodSpec.linear_attn_verify_extension`; the factory gets the
+`VllmConfig` and returns a `LinearAttnVerifyExtension`
+(`vllm/model_executor/layers/mamba/verify_extension.py`), whose
+`forward_spec_rows(rows)` receives the spec-decode rows of each forward as a
+`GDNSpecRows` and writes `rows.out`. The state layout stays vLLM's: row `i` of a
+request stores its states at `state_indices[b, i]`, and the next step resumes
+from `num_accepted_tokens - 1`. Qwen gated delta net layers consult it, and
+Mamba2 layers call `forward_mamba2_spec_rows(rows)` with a `Mamba2SpecRows`
+(ReplaySSM is refused with an extension); an extension that does not implement
+it raises at the first Mamba2 forward instead of verifying its drafts as chains.
+
+A speculator can also stop drafting when speculation no longer pays (for
+example, at large batch sizes). It sets `may_suspend_drafting = True` and
+overrides `suspend_drafting(num_reqs, req_ids)`, which Model Runner V2 asks once
+per scheduled batch. When it returns True, every request of the batch decodes
+with the target alone until it finishes: scheduled verification drains first,
+and then the batch runs on target-only attention metadata and decode CUDA graphs
+without draft KV. A batch that contains a suspended request stays suspended,
+because the skipped hidden states cannot populate the draft KV again. This path
+needs synchronous scheduling, eager execution or full decode graphs, and no
+prefix caching, KV transfer, DBO, context, data or pipeline parallelism, or
+recurrent replay/recovery; draft weights and KV capacity stay allocated.
+
+To verify fewer drafts than were scheduled (for example, a width chosen per
+step from measured costs), a speculator overrides
+`verify_budget(req_ids, num_draft_tokens)`. It returns how many of its scheduled
+drafts each request verifies this step; the remaining drafts count as rejected.
+The default verifies all of them. Built-in adaptive verification sets its own
+budget and takes precedence.
+
 ## `--speculative-config` schema
 
 Use `--speculative-config` to pass speculative decoding settings as a JSON

+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import cast
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import FusedMoEConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner import shared_experts as module
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner.shared_experts import (

+
+def make_shared(monkeypatch):
+    # Exercise the CUDA scheduling decision without allocating CUDA objects.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "aux_stream", lambda: object())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module.envs, "VLLM_DISABLE_SHARED_EXPERTS_STREAM", False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(module.current_platform, "is_cuda_alike", lambda: True)

+    return SharedExperts(
+        torch.nn.Identity(),
+        cast(FusedMoEConfig, SimpleNamespace(moe_parallel_config=parallel)),
+        enable_dbo=False,
+        mk_can_overlap_shared_experts=lambda: False,

+

+def test_disable_aux_stream_runs_shared_expert_inline(monkeypatch):
+    shared = make_shared(monkeypatch)
+    shared.disable_aux_stream()
+    x = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(1, 4)
+    assert not shared.maybe_forward_async(x)
+    shared(x, SharedExpertsOrder.NO_OVERLAP)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(shared.output, x)
+
+
+def test_disable_aux_stream_rejects_unconsumed_output(monkeypatch):
+    shared = make_shared(monkeypatch)
+    shared.disable_aux_stream()
+    x = torch.ones(1, 4)
+    shared(x, SharedExpertsOrder.NO_OVERLAP)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="unconsumed"):
+        shared.disable_aux_stream()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(shared.output, x)
+    shared.disable_aux_stream()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not torch.cuda.is_available(), reason="requires CUDA")
+def test_inline_shared_expert_replays_inside_conditional_graph():
+    parallel = SimpleNamespace(enable_eplb=False, use_fi_nvl_two_sided_kernels=False)
+    shared = SharedExperts(
+        torch.nn.Identity(),
+        cast(FusedMoEConfig, SimpleNamespace(moe_parallel_config=parallel)),
+        enable_dbo=False,
+        mk_can_overlap_shared_experts=lambda: False,
+    )
+    shared.disable_aux_stream()
+    x = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda").reshape(1, 4)
+    output = torch.zeros_like(x)
+    condition = torch.ones((), dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    if not hasattr(graph, "begin_capture_to_if_node"):
+        pytest.skip("requires conditional CUDA graph support")
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        graph.begin_capture_to_if_node(condition)
+        assert not shared.maybe_forward_async(x)
+        shared(x, SharedExpertsOrder.NO_OVERLAP)
+        output.copy_(shared.output)
+        graph.end_capture_to_conditional_node()
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, x)
+    condition.zero_()
+    output.fill_(-1)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, torch.full_like(x, -1))

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Extension point for verifying non-chain drafts on linear-attention layers.
+
+Gated delta net (GDN) and Mamba2 layers verify speculative tokens as a chain:
+row ``i`` of a request's query continues from row ``i - 1``, each row writes
+its own recurrent / convolution state to ``state_indices[req, i]``, and the
+next step resumes from row ``num_accepted_tokens - 1``. A draft *tree* needs
+row ``i`` to continue from another earlier row instead, which the in-tree
+kernels cannot express.
+
+A speculative method registered with ``register_speculative_method`` can set
+``SpeculativeMethodSpec.linear_attn_verify_extension`` to a factory for a
+``LinearAttnVerifyExtension``. Every ``GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder`` and
+``Mamba2AttentionMetadataBuilder`` then creates one and attaches it to the
+metadata it builds, and the layer hands the spec-decode rows of every forward
+to the extension (``forward_spec_rows`` for GDN, ``forward_mamba2_spec_rows``
+for Mamba2) instead of running its own convolution and recurrence on them.
+With no extension (the default) nothing changes.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import resolve_obj_by_qualname
+from vllm.v1.spec_decode.registry import get_speculative_method
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GDNSpecRows:
+    """The spec-decode rows of one GDN layer's forward.
+
+    ``T`` is the number of spec-decode tokens and ``B`` the number of their
+    requests (a CUDA graph batch may pad ``B``; the in-tree kernels see the
+    same padding). Heads and dims are per tensor-parallel rank.
+    """
+
+    layer_name: str
+    """The layer's prefix, its key in the forward context."""
+    mixed_qkv: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, conv_dim]`` convolution input (the q, k and v columns). May be a
+    view whose row stride is larger than ``conv_dim``."""
+    a: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads]`` decay gate input. May be a strided view."""
+    b: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads]`` beta gate input. May be a strided view."""
+    conv_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, conv_dim, kernel_size - 1]`` convolution states."""
+    conv_weight: torch.Tensor
+    """``[conv_dim, kernel_size]``."""
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor | None
+    activation: str | None
+    ssm_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, num_v_heads, head_v_dim, head_k_dim]`` recurrent states."""
+    A_log: torch.Tensor
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor
+    num_k_heads: int
+    num_v_heads: int
+    head_k_dim: int
+    head_v_dim: int
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B, max_query_len]``: the state slot of each row of each request."""
+    num_accepted_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B]``: request ``b`` starts from ``state_indices[b, n - 1]``."""
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B + 1]``: the rows of each request in ``mixed_qkv``."""
+    out: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_v_heads, head_v_dim]``, written by the extension."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Mamba2SpecRows:
+    """The spec-decode rows of one Mamba2 layer's forward.
+
+    ``T`` is the number of spec-decode tokens and ``B`` the number of their
+    requests (a CUDA graph batch may pad ``B``; the in-tree kernels see the
+    same padding). Heads and groups are per tensor-parallel rank.
+    """
+
+    layer_name: str
+    """The layer's prefix, its key in the forward context."""
+    hidden_states_B_C: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, conv_dim]`` convolution input (the x, B and C columns). May be a
+    view whose row stride is larger than ``conv_dim``."""
+    dt: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_heads]`` time step before ``dt_bias`` and softplus. May be a
+    strided view."""
+    conv_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, conv_dim, kernel_size - 1 + num_spec]`` convolution
+    states."""
+    conv_weight: torch.Tensor
+    """``[conv_dim, kernel_size]``."""
+    conv_bias: torch.Tensor | None
+    activation: str | None
+    ssm_state: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_slots, num_heads, head_dim, ssm_state_size]`` SSM states."""
+    A: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]`` float32 (``-exp(A_log)``)."""
+    D: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]``."""
+    dt_bias: torch.Tensor
+    """``[num_heads]``; the in-tree kernels use ``softplus(dt + dt_bias)``."""
+    num_heads: int
+    head_dim: int
+    n_groups: int
+    ssm_state_size: int
+    state_indices: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B, max_query_len]``: the state slot of each row of each request."""
+    num_accepted_tokens: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B]``: request ``b`` starts from ``state_indices[b, n - 1]``."""
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    """``[B + 1]``: the rows of each request in ``hidden_states_B_C``."""
+    out: torch.Tensor
+    """``[T, num_heads * head_dim]`` SSM output (before the gated norm),
+    written by the extension."""
+
+
+class LinearAttnVerifyExtension:
+    """Runs the convolution and the recurrence of a GDN or Mamba2 layer's
+    spec-decode rows in place of the in-tree chain kernels.
+
+    State layout contract (the in-tree chain one): row ``i`` of request ``b``
+    stores its convolution and recurrent state at ``state_indices[b, i]``; the
+    initial state of request ``b`` is at ``state_indices[b,
+    num_accepted_tokens[b] - 1]``. A tree verifier keeps that layout and
+    computes row ``i`` from the row it continues; before the next step it moves
+    the accepted path's states into chain order.
+    """
+
+    def forward_spec_rows(self, rows: GDNSpecRows) -> None:
+        """Write the attention output of every spec-decode row to ``rows.out``
+        and every row's states as described above. Called for every forward
+        with spec-decode rows, including CUDA graph captures."""
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def forward_mamba2_spec_rows(self, rows: Mamba2SpecRows) -> None:
+        """As ``forward_spec_rows``, for a Mamba2 layer's decode rows."""
+        raise NotImplementedError(
+            f"{type(self).__name__} does not verify Mamba2 layers; the "
+            "in-tree kernels would verify its drafts as chains"
+        )
+
+
+def create_linear_attn_verify_extension(
+    vllm_config: "VllmConfig",
+) -> LinearAttnVerifyExtension | None:
+    """The extension of the registered speculative method, if it has one."""
+    speculative_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if speculative_config is None:
+        return None
+    registered = get_speculative_method(speculative_config.method)
+    if registered is None or registered.linear_attn_verify_extension is None:
+        return None
+    factory = resolve_obj_by_qualname(
+        registered.linear_attn_verify_extension.replace(":", ".")
+    )
+    return factory(vllm_config)

+def native_decode_config(config: "VllmConfig") -> "VllmConfig":
+    """Create target-only metadata without publishing unpopulated draft KV."""
+    parallel = config.parallel_config
+    cache = config.cache_config
+    if config.compilation_config.cudagraph_mode.has_piecewise_cudagraphs():
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Native draft suspension requires eager execution or "
+            "full decode graphs; piecewise graph caches are not isolated."
+        )
+    if (
+        config.scheduler_config.async_scheduling
+        or any(
+            size != 1
+            for size in (
+                parallel.pipeline_parallel_size,
+                parallel.data_parallel_size,
+                parallel.prefill_context_parallel_size,
+                parallel.decode_context_parallel_size,
+            )
+        )
+        or parallel.enable_dbo
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Native draft suspension requires synchronous scheduling, "
+            "PP=DP=PCP=DCP=1 and DBO disabled."
+        )
+    if cache.enable_prefix_caching or config.kv_transfer_config is not None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Native draft suspension requires prefix caching and KV transfer "
+            "disabled: suspended draft blocks are not populated."
+        )
+    if (
+        cache.mamba_cache_mode != "none"
+        or cache.use_replayssm
+        or cache.use_kda_recoverssm
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Native draft suspension requires mamba_cache_mode=none, "
+            "ReplaySSM and RecoverSSM disabled."
+        )
+    native = copy(config)
+    native.speculative_config = None

+
+class NativeDecodeState:
+    """Track irreversible draft suspension by request ID, not batch position.
+
+    ``suspend(num_reqs, req_ids)`` (the speculator's ``suspend_drafting``)
+    decides which batches start a suspension. A batch containing a suspended
+    request suspends all its requests. A drafter cannot catch up missing hidden
+    states after an OFF step. Finish, not filtering or preemption, ends
+    suspension. Pending verification is drained, followed by one target-only
+    step to consume its accepted recurrent-state offset before selecting
+    native metadata/graphs. No draft work runs during either drain.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, suspend: Callable[[int, Collection[str]], bool]) -> None:
+        self.suspend = suspend
+        self.disabled: set[str] = set()
+        self.pending_state: set[str] = set()
+
+    def select(
+        self,
+        req_ids: Collection[str],
+        finished_req_ids: Collection[str],
+        drafted_req_ids: Collection[str],
+    ) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
+        """Return (skip drafting, use native target) for this scheduled batch."""
+        self.disabled.difference_update(finished_req_ids)
+        self.pending_state.difference_update(finished_req_ids)
+        disable = bool(req_ids) and (
+            self.suspend(len(req_ids), req_ids) or not self.disabled.isdisjoint(req_ids)

+        native = (
+            disable and not drafted_req_ids and self.pending_state.isdisjoint(req_ids)
+        )
+        if disable:
+            self.disabled.update(req_ids)
+        self.pending_state.difference_update(req_ids)
+        self.pending_state.update(drafted_req_ids)
+        return disable, native
